value.behaviour: The repo's own peer-deps fixer rewrites the 56 generated peer-range manifests from U01's constants, then Yarn updates the lockfile in place to match the narrowed ranges.
rules: The 56 manifests are generated output (NFR-3) — no typed unit in this spec writes a peer block. This step is the only thing that changes them.

Going through the fixer is what preserves the peer-block outliers: `plugins/permission-react` has no `react-router-dom` peer and `plugins/scaffolder-react` carries `react-router: ^6.30.3` beside `react-router-dom: ^6.30.2` (NFR-7). Both survive because the fixer rewrites only the keys its constants name.
`yarn install --no-immutable` updates the lockfile incrementally (FR-3); the lockfile is never regenerated from scratch, and `.yarn/patches` and the repo-local Yarn plugin are untouched.
This step runs after U01 so the fixer reads the new constants, and after U02, U03 and U04 so their line-numbered sites were applied to the manifests before the fixer re-serializes them.
